provider: NASA JPL OPERA / Physical Oceanography Distributed Active Archive Center (PO.DAAC) / NASA Common Metadata Repository (CMR)
api_version: NASA CMR search API; OPERA_L3_DSWX-S1_V1 collection C2949811996-POCLOUD, version 1.0

request_contract.parameter_rules: DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, NO LIVE AUTOMATION AUTHORIZED: CMR collections search must select exact concept_id=C2949811996-POCLOUD. A future independently reviewed granule search may select that exact collection_concept_id with a fixed UTC time window, bounded AOI and page_size=1. Reject arbitrary collection IDs, product versions, hosts, URLs, credentials, custom headers, arbitrary download links, redirects, pagination and all caller-supplied filters until new review. Never treat public CMR catalogue links as permission to download protected NASA Earthdata files.

response_contract.format: NASA CMR UMM-JSON public collection and granule discovery metadata only; no satellite GeoTIFF or calibrated classified pixels.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Metadata returns OPERA DSWx-S1 product and granule discovery identity, not independent flood occurrence, water depth, return period or site-specific hazard. Product is Sentinel-1 SAR-derived 30 m surface-water classification plus confidence layers; 6-12 day nominal revisit does not ensure event-time coverage. Retain observed acquisition UTC, tile ID, product processing version, classification/QA flags and possible overlap in Sentinel-1 evidence with CEMS Global Flood Monitoring.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No API fetch or catalogue probing is authorized by this documentation-only contract. On a separate reviewed T1 scope, use at most one trusted anonymous CMR metadata request and no redirects, bulk enumeration, unbounded pagination, or recurring polling. Keep any future granule download on a separately authorized credentialed pathway.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: CMR metadata and per-granule links may change. Any future execution receipt must bind request identity, CMR concept ID and revision, granule collection and observation UTC, retrieval UTC, response byte count, SHA-256, parser version and final redirect chain; it cannot establish an immutable data-byte identity without a separate original-file receipt.

rights_and_policy.notes: The AWS Open Data Registry names CC BY 4.0 for the NASA SNWG/OPERA project and identifies OPERA_L3_DSWX-S1_V1 assets as a protected S3 collection requiring Earthdata Login/AWS temporary credentials in us-west-2. This is useful rights evidence but does not constitute source-specific reviewed attribution/republication/commercial entitlement for individual modified Copernicus Sentinel input and granule products. Both data redistribution and automated catalogue/service terms remain unapproved; no probe until independently reviewed.

notes: This file documents only a public CMR metadata interface and provider-controlled asset-access boundary. Actual DSWx-S1 GeoTIFFs live under protected podaac-ops-cumulus-protected/OPERA_L3_DSWX-S1_V1 and require Earthdata Login and AWS short-term credentials. No retrieval, tiles, samples, Earthdata tokens, real building overlays, original provider bytes, model inputs, or Neon database writes are authorized. See source intake #1130 and candidate PR #1133.
